task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a Cirq program computing linear cross-entropy benchmarking (XEB) fidelity of random single-qubit-rotation + CZ circuits on 4 qubits, depth 16, comparing a noiseless sampler against the ideal probabilities (expected XEB ≈ 1). Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
